headline: Linn Mercy's Last Warden Post Falls; Mooring County Seesaws
war_summary: Since the last edition the flags have tilted further: Linn Mercy's final Warden post has fallen, leaving all ten of its surviving strongholds under the Colonial flag and one ground in ruin. The fresher story is Mooring County, where the Warden margin of nine to three has been whittled to six to five; flags were still changing hands as this edition went to press, The Wind Hills and Gravekeeper's Holdfast the busiest grounds. Weathered Expanse remains the sternest exchange, now four Warden posts to three Colonial, though the hourly toll eases from its peak about Crow's Nest. Callums Cape, the day's bloodiest field with some 17,000 casualties apiece in twenty-four hours, stands four Colonial to three Warden and has gone quiet these two hours past. Stlican Shelf's losses climb anew around Briar, while Marban Hollow stays still and Nevish Line, Godcrofts and Stonecradle report no flag movement for many hours. Nearly four of every five strategic posts across the map fly Colonial colours. It is the 802nd day; thirty-four victory towns must fall, and no victor is declared.
